description: Fallback called only when normal attribute lookup raises `AttributeError`; it must return a value or raise `AttributeError`.
Called for every attribute read on the instance; it reaches its own state through `object.__getattribute__` to avoid infinite recursion.
Called for every assignment and deletion, including those in `__init__`; `object.__setattr__` performs the normal store.
Returns the names `dir()` lists; proxies extend it with the target's names for introspection and autocompletion.
Implicit calls such as `len(obj)` or `obj + 1` look the dunder up on the type and bypass both attribute hooks.
